description: Phantom displayed at Riva Mahallesi in Beykoz. No contributor has linked an identity so tail_number is deliberately blank and the sub-variant is unresolved. spottingmode status preserved last updated 4 November 2024. Separately the International F-104 Society records CF-104 104756 at a complex entrance at Çayağzı west of Riva since mid 2011; that is a different airframe at a different point and no coordinate could be established for it.
